title: The reeve's very first 'roads out of the Vale' summary (west=Thornwold, east=Fenmarch via the causeway, north=Wardmoor) never mentions that Fenmarch is also reachable directly from the Saltkerns' coast road — that connection was found by accident while walking toward the smugglers' stair, well after visiting Fenmarch the 'intended' way would have made more sense chronologically.
